title: Application of New England Power Company for authorization and approval from the Department of Public Utilities of: (1) one or more additional issues of General and Refunding Mortgage Bonds, (2) one or more additional issues of First Mortgage Bonds, (3) execution of one or more loan agreements or supplemental loan agreements in connection with financing expenditures related to pollution control equipment, and (4) an exemption from the provisions of Section 15 of chapter 164 of the General Laws.
petitioner: New England Power Company d/b/a National Grid
